package.title: 100 Computer Literacy MCQs for Clerical Recruitment Practice

questions.question: Which component executes instructions and performs calculations in a computer?
Which of these is an input device?
Which device is primarily used to produce a paper copy of a document?
Which type of memory normally loses its contents when the computer is switched off?
What is the main purpose of an operating system?
choices: To manage computer resources and provide services for applications
To act only as a storage device

questions.question: Which item is software rather than physical hardware?
Which unit is commonly used to describe a processor's clock frequency?
Which storage device has no moving disk platters and commonly uses flash memory?
What does a computer's power supply unit do?
choices: Converts incoming electrical power into forms usable by computer components

questions.question: Which device is most suitable for entering spoken instructions into a computer?
Which is an example of an output device?
What is the usual purpose of a computer network?
choices: To connect devices so they can communicate or share resources
To make every computer use the same password
To convert every file into a printed page

questions.question: Which unit is the smallest among these data-size units?
What does a UPS commonly provide to a desktop computer during a brief power failure?
Which is an example of application software?
What is the main function of a web browser?
choices: To retrieve and display web pages

questions.question: Which device can convert a paper page into a digital image?
Which statement best describes a folder on a computer?
choices: A container used to organise files and other folders
A physical part that stores electricity
A command that permanently deletes the operating system

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a backup?
choices: To keep a recoverable copy of data in case the original is lost or damaged
To guarantee that a file has no viruses
To increase the keyboard's typing speed

questions.question: Which action is most likely to reduce the risk of losing unsaved work during a power interruption?
In a file manager, what does a file extension such as .pdf generally indicate?
choices: The amount of electricity the file uses

questions.question: Which extension is commonly associated with a plain-text file?
Which action normally copies selected text without removing it from its original location?
What is the usual effect of pressing Ctrl+Z in many desktop applications?
choices: Save and close the current file

questions.question: Which keyboard shortcut commonly saves the current document on Windows desktop applications?
Which shortcut commonly opens a search or Find box in a document?
A user wants to rename a file without changing its contents. Which action is appropriate?
choices: Use the file manager's Rename command

questions.question: What is the usual purpose of the Recycle Bin or Trash?
choices: To hold certain deleted items temporarily before permanent removal
To store every password used on the computer
To scan all emails for spelling errors
To improve the computer's screen resolution

questions.question: Which action is safest before removing a USB storage device from a computer?
choices: Use the system's eject or safely remove option when available
Pull it out while files are being copied

questions.question: A file appears in the wrong folder. Which action moves it without intentionally creating a second copy?
choices: Cut the file and paste it into the destination folder
Copy the file and leave both copies in place
Print the file and delete the folder

questions.question: Which file extension commonly identifies a Microsoft Word document in the modern DOCX format?
Which file extension commonly identifies a modern Microsoft Excel workbook?
What is the main purpose of a compressed archive file?
choices: To package files together and often reduce their storage size
To display a spreadsheet as a video
To prevent all possible malware infections

questions.question: A user accidentally deletes a file and has not emptied the Recycle Bin. What is a sensible first recovery step?
choices: Open the Recycle Bin and restore the file if it is there
Install a random program from an unknown website

questions.question: In a word processor, which feature changes the space between lines of a paragraph?
Which alignment setting places text evenly between the left and right margins?
Which command applies a slanted style to selected text?
What is the main benefit of using built-in heading styles in a long document?
choices: They apply consistent formatting and can support automatic navigation
They convert all text into images
They automatically verify every factual claim

questions.question: Which feature is best suited to creating a list with items marked by dots?
What does the spell-check feature generally do?
choices: Flags words that may be misspelled according to its dictionary
Guarantees that every sentence is factually correct
Creates a backup on a separate computer

questions.question: A report needs page numbers at the bottom of each page. Which area is commonly used?
Which page orientation makes a page wider than it is tall?
What does the Print Preview feature help a user do?
choices: Check how a document is likely to appear when printed
Send the document to every contact
Recover a file that was never saved

questions.question: Which feature is appropriate for creating personalised letters from a standard document and a recipient list?
In a word processor, what does Find and Replace do?
choices: Searches for specified text and substitutes other text

questions.question: Which feature records edits and comments so another reviewer can inspect proposed changes?
What does the Undo command do after an accidental formatting change?
choices: Reverses the most recent action if it is undoable
Deletes every version of the document
Sends the document to a printer

questions.question: Which command is best for keeping headings visually distinct from body text throughout a report?
What is a page break used for in a document?
choices: To start following content on a new page
To change a word into a hyperlink

questions.question: Which word-processing feature is most suitable for checking the total number of words in a report?
Which command commonly places a copy of selected text at the current cursor position?
In a spreadsheet, what is the address of the cell at column C and row 5?
In a spreadsheet, what does the formula =B2+C2 calculate?
choices: The sum of the values in B2 and C2
The average of every cell in row 2
The text in B2 followed by the text in C2 in every spreadsheet program
The number of empty cells in column C

questions.question: Which spreadsheet function calculates the arithmetic mean of a range of numeric cells?
If A1 contains 7 and A2 contains 5, what value does =A1*A2 return?
If B1 is 20 and B2 is 4, what does =B1/B2 return?
Which formula adds the values in cells C2 through C8 in a typical spreadsheet?
A spreadsheet formula in D2 is =B2+C2. If it is copied one row down using a relative reference, what will it normally become?
In a spreadsheet formula, what does the reference $A$1 indicate?
choices: Both the column and row are fixed when the formula is copied
The cell contains a currency symbol

questions.question: Which function counts cells containing numbers in a referenced range in common spreadsheet software?
Which function returns the largest numeric value in a range?
What is the result of =SUM(3,4,5) in a spreadsheet that uses commas to separate function arguments?
A cell shows #### instead of a numeric value. What is a common first adjustment to try?
choices: Change the cell value to a password

questions.question: Which chart is generally suitable for comparing values across separate categories, such as monthly office expenses?
Which chart is commonly used to show how categories make up a single whole, when there are only a few categories?
Which formula calculates the difference between the value in A2 and the value in B2?
If a spreadsheet cell contains the formula =2+3*4, what is the result under standard arithmetic precedence?
Which formula returns the smaller of the values in cells D1 and D2?
What does a filter in a spreadsheet typically do to a table?
choices: Shows rows that meet selected conditions while hiding other rows from view
Permanently deletes every row that does not match
Adds a password to every cell

questions.question: Which feature arranges spreadsheet records alphabetically by a selected text column?
Why might a user freeze the top row of a long spreadsheet?
choices: To keep column headings visible while scrolling
To prevent all data from being edited
To convert the sheet into a PDF

questions.question: Which formula adds 10 percent to the value in A1?
If A1 contains 80, what is the result of =A1*0.25?
Which spreadsheet command is suitable for displaying long text on multiple lines within a cell?
In an email, what does the CC field normally do?
choices: Sends a visible copy of the message to additional recipients
Hides all recipients from one another

questions.question: When is BCC especially useful in an email?
choices: When sending to many recipients whose addresses should not be shown to one another
When attaching a file too large to send
When marking a message as unread

questions.question: What should a user normally do before opening an unexpected email attachment?
choices: Check whether the sender and message are genuine, and avoid opening it if suspicious
Rename it without inspecting the message

questions.question: Which is the strongest password among these choices?
choices: A long, unique passphrase with a mix of words and characters

questions.question: What is the main purpose of multi-factor authentication?
choices: To require an additional proof of identity beyond the password
To remove the need for software updates
To increase the size of a file

questions.question: A message claims that an account will be closed unless the user clicks an unfamiliar link and enters a password. What is the safest response?
choices: Avoid the link and check the account through its known official app or address
Reply with the password to confirm identity
Forward the message to unknown contacts

questions.question: What does HTTPS in a website address indicate in ordinary browsing?
choices: The connection uses encryption between the browser and the site
The website is guaranteed to be honest and safe
The user's computer cannot be infected

questions.question: Which practice is safest when using a public computer to access an account?
choices: Sign out when finished and avoid saving the password in the browser
Leave the account open for the next user
Use the same password as every other account
Save private files to a shared desktop

questions.question: What is phishing?
choices: A deceptive attempt to obtain sensitive information by impersonation
A method of cooling a processor
A way to organise folders alphabetically

questions.question: Which action is appropriate if a work email contains confidential information and was sent to the wrong recipient?
choices: Follow workplace reporting procedures promptly and avoid further sharing
Post the message publicly to warn others
Send it to more people to confirm delivery
Delete the sent message and assume no one received it

questions.question: What is a browser bookmark used for?
choices: Saving a link for easier access later
Blocking every advertisement on the internet

questions.question: A website requests a file download that the user did not intend to obtain. What is a sensible action?
choices: Cancel the download and verify the site's legitimacy before proceeding
Share the download link with colleagues

questions.question: Which email subject line is most useful for a message requesting approval of a specific office supply purchase?
What is the purpose of an email attachment?
choices: To send a file along with the message
To hide the sender's identity automatically
To make a message impossible to forward

questions.question: What should a user check before sending a document as an email attachment?
choices: That the intended file is attached and the message is addressed correctly
That the monitor is set to maximum brightness
That every folder on the computer is renamed
That the document has been printed twice

questions.question: Which practice helps reduce the risk of losing important office files?
choices: Keep regular backups in an appropriate separate location
Store the only copy on a shared public computer
Rename files with no pattern and never back them up
Delete files whenever the computer is slow

questions.question: A printer is switched on but prints from the wrong application-selected printer. What should the user check first?
choices: Whether the correct printer is selected in the print dialog
Whether the document's font is italic
Whether the mouse pad is clean
Whether the computer's clock uses a 12-hour format

questions.question: A printer produces blank pages even though the computer shows that a job was sent. Which basic check is most relevant?
choices: Check the printer's paper, ink or toner, and displayed status

questions.question: A computer cannot access a website, but other websites load normally. What is a sensible first step?
choices: Check the address and try again, then consider whether that site is temporarily unavailable

questions.question: A document application stops responding while a user is editing. Which action best protects recent work if recovery options are available?
choices: Wait briefly and use the application's recovery prompt or saved recovery copy
Unplug every connected device while saving is in progress
Delete the document from the file manager

questions.question: A user receives a message that appears to come from a colleague but asks for an urgent password reset through a strange link. What should the user do?
choices: Verify the request with the colleague through a known channel and avoid the strange link
Enter the current password to test the link
Send the password to the colleague by email

questions.question: A spreadsheet formula returns a division-by-zero error. What should the user inspect first?
choices: Whether the divisor cell is zero or blank
Whether the monitor is plugged in
Whether the workbook has a page footer

questions.question: A user wants to share a document for review while reducing the chance that the recipient changes the original file. What is a practical approach?
choices: Send a separate copy or an appropriately restricted review version
Send the only original and delete all backups
Paste the document into the email subject

questions.question: A user is about to install a software update on an office computer. Which practice is generally safest?
choices: Use the recognised update mechanism or an authorised source and follow workplace procedures
Download an installer from an unknown pop-up
Share administrator credentials in a public message

questions.question: A user wants to make text easy to scan in a short office notice. Which layout choice is usually most helpful for separate action items?
choices: Put all items in one unbroken paragraph
Use a different font for every word

questions.question: Which statement best describes firmware in a computer device?
choices: It is software stored in a device that helps control its basic operation.
It is temporary data held only while an application is open.
It is a physical connection used to link a computer to a printer.
It is a folder used to organise downloaded files.
